title: VECTOR BREAKTHROUGH #1: INORGANIC MATTERS OPEN
lines: DETAILS: During the event, Vector Breakthrough event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can earn 'Caution! Wet Floor!' by completing event stages and level up [Breakthrough Milestone] to receive corresponding event rewards.
REWARDS: Bloodline of Combat Collection - Ignis for Vulcan, Event furniture, Module materials, Elite materials, Battle Records, LMD and more.
◆ For detailed event information, please stay tuned to our official social media.

DETAILS: During the Orienteering Headhunting, you can select and lock in three 6-star and three 5-star Operators of this pool and raise their rates. The three selected 6-star Operators will be the only 6-star Operators in this headhunting.
★★★★★★(2%): Degenbrecher / Reed the Flame Shadow / Narantuya / Horn / Ray / Thorns the Lodestar
★★★★★(8%): Quercus / Wind Chimes / Spuria / Nowell / Figurino / Hibiscus the Purifier

This is a Standard Headhunting. Once the rate-up Operators are selected, only the three selected 6-star Operators will appear in this pool, making up 100% of the 6-star Operators' pull rate. All 5-star Operators from the Standard Headhunting pool may appear, while the three selected 5-star Operators have a boosted rate, comprising 60% of the 5-star Operators' pull rate.
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENTS: Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 2, Originite Prime * 9
CONTENTS: Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2, Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1
Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 6-star Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
CONTENTS: Module Data Block * 24, Data Supplement Instrument * 30, Data Supplement Stick * 90
ID Info Update Card Pack (Free) (Limited to 1 purchase)
ID Info Update Card Pack (Limited to 1 purchase)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
Please stay tuned for more information!
